dismissed_comment: Admission guard itself: admitCwd must canonicalize the raw request cwd with a read-only fs.realpath (metadata only) to decide admit/refuse/indeterminate; consumers branch on admissionAllows() (modelled guard) before touching disk. Same as #389. Change harden-plugin-cwd-admission.
Existence probe on a cwd already admitted by isAllowedCwd (known/pinned folders, realpath-canonicalized) in every handler; same pattern as develop alert #269. No new trust boundary.
